description.fun: Spheal's body isn't built for swimming and it waddles slowly, so it gets around by rolling across the ice floes. When it's happy, especially when eating with friends, it claps its flippers, which makes Spheal mealtimes very noisy, and it's even been seen clapping in its sleep. Sealeo like to balance Spheal on their noses and roll them around to check they're healthy.
description.guide: An Ice- and Water-type Pokémon based on a seal and a ball, insulated by fluffy fur and blubber, living in the sea and on drift ice. It evolves into Sealeo at level 32.
description.tagline: A ball-shaped seal that rolls on ice and claps when happy

description.fun: Sealeo checks out anything new by balancing it on its nose and rolling it around to test how it smells and feels, a bit like a sea lion's ball trick. It does the same with Spheal, sniffing them to make sure they're healthy. Its whiskers are super-sensitive, and it dives five times a day to hunt, tracking prey by scent. Its Japanese name, Todoggler, mixes todo (sea lion) with 'juggler'.
description.guide: An Ice- and Water-type Pokémon resembling a seal with elements of a walrus, living in the sea and on drift ice. It evolves from Spheal at level 32 and into Walrein at level 44, the only Pokémon that evolves at that level.
description.tagline: A seal that balances anything new on its nose

description.fun: Walrein's long tusks can smash 10 tonnes of ice in one blow, and they keep growing all its life, so a tusk broken in battle grows back by the next year; the Hisui region is famous for the broken Walrein tusks found there. Its thick blubber keeps out the cold and makes attacks bounce off. It lives in herds of 20 to 30, and the leader will give its life to protect them.
description.guide: An Ice- and Water-type Pokémon based on a walrus, with huge tusks and a thick layer of blubber, living in icy seas. It evolves from Sealeo at level 44 and is the final form of Spheal.
description.tagline: A tusked walrus king that guards its herd with its life
